title: Uncontrolled Delegation Mapping: At What Point Do Agents Over-Delegate to Sub-Agents?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Tests whether agents over-delegate and whether that correlates with safety failures. Addresses a named failure mode. The link from identifying over-delegation to preventing it is plausible but requires follow-up work.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires building a multi-agent orchestration system where the agent can choose to delegate or not, with configurable sub-agent count. Multi-agent setup is complex for beginners. Managing 1-3 sub-agents per task adds engineering overhead.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 15 tasks with delegation measurement is moderate scope. The experimental design is clean: observe natural delegation patterns. If the multi-agent framework is pre-built (e.g., AutoGen), this could fit in 30hrs.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
